service_boundaries.rationale: Compiler, kernel and allocation primitives remain explicit host services.

The target body is the C99 single-precision sine service with its scalar hard-float argument and result in s0; native consumers bind it to the host C math runtime instead of translating the library implementation as gameplay code.

0x0046C204 is the target-proven nngxValidateState dirty-PICA-state emitter: a CTR/nngx platform-library service that serializes shadow GPU state into the guest command list. It is outside gameplay-source ownership. Source closure does not imply a typed native implementation or runtime-import acceptance; this entry remains on the A32/whole-AOT fallback until a differential-tested native service adapter is accepted.
